The fix is commit `21ea98bd` (PR #6537, "TRUNK-6796: Fix NPE when death date is null when merging patients"). It changed the null check in `PersonMergeLogData.computeHashValue()` so it tests `getPriorDateOfDeath()` instead of `getPriorDateOfBirth()`. The commit also adds a regression test, `PersonMergeLogDataTest`, which sets only the prior date of birth and asserts that `computeHashValue()` does not throw.

The diff changes one line, 445 after the fix (it was the same expression with the wrong getter before). The `computeHashValue()` method starts above line 395, so I did not confirm its opening line; the cited span covers its tail.

Evidence, best first:

- Commit `21ea98bdb1d1ca38a2986de62de17b8e3f7bd8a3` (openmrs-core), the fix.
- PR #6537 in openmrs-core, which the commit title references.
- Fixed null check at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/person/PersonMergeLogData.java` line 445.
- The surrounding hash computation, lines 442–447.
- The new regression test `openmrs-core/api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/person/PersonMergeLogDataTest.java`, lines 1–27.
- Ticket TRUNK-6796.
